profile_ladder.note: illustrative profiles defined by parameters in tools/popoto_stage2_study.py; not data

conditioning_only.what: baseband conversion and pulse compression of one full-length ping (recon.prepare, host), from the raw ping and through the decimate-first stage; shorter of two runs

host.note: measured on a shared machine with a load average of 9 to 17 on 4 threads: runs of one configuration differed by up to 30%; each figure is the shorter of two runs; read the ratios before the seconds

blanking.formula: min range = c (pulse length + recovery_s + taper_s) / 2

datagram_fields_required.time_ns: time of validity of the fix, ns since the Unix epoch, on the same time base as the boards' capture time
datagram_fields_required.roll, pitch, yaw: rad; rotation z-y-x from north-east-down to the vehicle's forward-right-down axes
datagram_fields_required.x, y, z: m north, east, down in one frame for the whole mission; z minus elevation.surface_z is the depth

datagram_fields_wanted.vx, vy, vz: m/s over ground, north-east-down (the Doppler log's velocity turned by the attitude)
datagram_fields_wanted.altitude, bottom_lock: m above the bottom from the Doppler log, and whether it has the bottom: water depth = depth + altitude
datagram_fields_wanted.sound_speed: m/s at the vehicle: range scaling, the local rung of the ladder, and the samples the vehicle's own profile is built from
datagram_fields_wanted.roll_sigma: rad: goes into every elevation and depth sigma in place of elevation.roll_sigma_deg when larger
datagram_fields_wanted.pitch_sigma, yaw_sigma, position_sigma,: carried into the record; not used by the chain yet

navigation.attitude_rate_rule: a roll of amplitude A at frequency f, sampled every dt and interpolated linearly, is wrong by at most A (2 pi f dt)^2 / 8
